metadata.title: Fresh e-GP public recheck: FY 2569 TMD S-band technical-evaluation disclosure
metadata.method: Search each project ID in the public e-GP All Web UI, then re-query the project-detail and related-document endpoints exposed by that page.
metadata.finding: The public portal still exposes three submitters and two technical passers for each project, but no written failure reason, score sheet, TOR compliance matrix, or committee evaluation report.
metadata.evidence_rule: This is a disclosure recheck. It does not infer why any bidder failed and does not treat the repeated outcome as proof of wrongdoing.
